architecture.label: THE BUILDING BLOCKS

workflow.heading: A useful workflow.
workflow.body: For a care team, an administrator, or the people you build for.

architecture.caption: Care Core provides shared healthcare capabilities. Add the frontend, backend, or integration your feature needs to create a focused workflow.

hero.title: Build your next healthcare application <accent>on Care.</accent>
hero.body: Create plugins, integrations and AI-assisted workflows on an open-source healthcare platform. Start with the walkthrough, use the developer tools, and bring your idea to life.
hero.footnote: Your idea. A shared foundation. Open source.

walkthrough.title: See how to build on Care.
walkthrough.body: A walkthrough to help you get started with Care’s developer tools and plugin ecosystem.
walkthrough.note: Get oriented, then take the next step with the scaffold and documentation below.

player.label: CARE / DEVELOPER WALKTHROUGH
player.title: See where your idea begins.

platform.title:
Extend the platform.

Build your workflow.
platform.body: Reuse Care’s patient and encounter data, forms, scheduling, and organizational structure. Keep your extension focused on the new experience you want to create.

frontend.title: Frontend plugins
frontend.description: Add the interface your users need: a view, a navigation entry, or a component in an existing workflow.
frontend.detail: React apps declare supported extension points in a {file} and can be delivered through Vite module federation.

backend.title: Backend plugins
backend.description: Add server-side logic, APIs, or a connection to an external service. Keep service credentials on the server.
backend.detail: Django apps register with Care’s PlugManager and expose their own namespaced API routes.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect a device or another system to a focused Care workflow using the available APIs and extension points.
integrations.detail: Use a frontend, a backend, or both as needed. Check the supported interfaces for your target Care version.

platform.footer: Not every feature needs both a frontend and a backend plugin. Some ideas may need changes to core.

start.title: From an idea to your first plugin.
start.body: Start small. Make one workflow work from end to end.

workflow.title: Choose a focused workflow
workflow.body: Define the user, their problem, and one useful outcome. Choose a small feature you can demonstrate with synthetic data.

workspace.title: Set up your workspace
workspace.body: The Care scaffold brings together plugin-building guidance and frontend and backend templates in an isolated development workspace.
workspace.prerequisites: Have Git, Node.js/npm, Python 3, and Docker with Compose available. Check the current setup instructions for required versions and environment checks.

tools.title: Build with the right tools
tools.agent: With an AI coding agent: use the starter prompt and let the scaffold’s plugin-building guidance help shape your implementation.
tools.docs: With the documentation: follow the plugin guide and use the templates as a starting point.

test.title: Test the workflow
test.body: Run the demo end to end. Check permissions, write clear setup instructions, and document limitations. A working prototype is the starting point for further validation.

note.title: Build with synthetic data.
note.body: Use synthetic data while developing and demonstrating your project. Before using a solution in clinical care, validate the workflow and review security, access controls, privacy and operational requirements.

starterPrompt.label: YOUR IDEA → A PLAN
starterPrompt.title: Start a useful conversation.
starterPrompt.body: Give your coding agent the context it needs. Replace the feature description with your idea.
starterPrompt.helpIdle: Copies text only. Nothing is installed or run.
starterPrompt.helpCopied: Copied. Paste it into your coding agent and add your feature.
starterPrompt.helpManual: Clipboard unavailable. The prompt is selected above; copy it manually.

examples.title:
Real code.

Useful starting points.
examples.body: Look inside two extensions to see how the pieces fit. These are reference implementations; check their setup, dependencies, and compatibility with your Care version.

backendExample.description: See a Django plugin authenticate Care users, check facility permissions, and issue short-lived Medispeak session tokens.
backendExample.detail: Service credentials stay on the server.

frontendExample.description: Explore a React app that extracts patient details from photographed forms and fills registration fields for user review.
frontendExample.detail: A reference for extending the Care interface.
